meaning: Calendar day the values belong to
plain explanation and why it matters: One row per day, 2001-01-01 to 2025-12-31 by default. Gaps show as empty values, not missing rows.

meaning: Latitude you asked for, rounded to 4 decimals
plain explanation and why it matters: The farm or test location. The weather values do NOT come from this exact spot, see the note on resolution.

meaning: Longitude you asked for, rounded to 4 decimals
plain explanation and why it matters: Same as lat.

meaning: Nigerian state of the coordinate
plain explanation and why it matters: Lets you compare locations by state.

meaning: Nigerian geopolitical zone of the coordinate
plain explanation and why it matters: Lets you group locations by the six zones.

meaning: Average air temperature 2 m above ground, for the day
plain explanation and why it matters: Overall warmth of the day. Drives how fast crops grow and how fast residues and soil organic matter break down.
where the meaning comes from: POWER response; wording from POWER parameter name

meaning: Highest air temperature of the day at 2 m
plain explanation and why it matters: Heat stress indicator. Very hot days at flowering can cut maize and legume yields. The usable threshold depends on the crop.
where the meaning comes from: POWER response; wording from POWER parameter name

meaning: Lowest air temperature of the day at 2 m
plain explanation and why it matters: Cold stress and night warmth. Warm nights speed up crop respiration; cool nights matter mostly in the Jos Plateau and highlands.
where the meaning comes from: POWER response; wording from POWER parameter name

meaning: Dew point temperature at 2 m
plain explanation and why it matters: Shows how much moisture is in the air. The closer it is to the air temperature, the more humid and muggy the day, which favours leaf diseases.
where the meaning comes from: POWER response; wording from POWER parameter name

meaning: Relative humidity at 2 m
plain explanation and why it matters: How damp the air is. High humidity favours fungal diseases and slows drying of harvested grain; low humidity (harmattan season) dries crops and soil quickly.
where the meaning comes from: POWER response; wording from POWER parameter name

meaning: Wind speed 2 m above ground
plain explanation and why it matters: Strong wind dries soil and lodges tall crops such as maize and sorghum. Also part of the evaporation calculation.
where the meaning comes from: POWER response; wording from POWER parameter name

meaning: Rainfall total for the day, bias-corrected
plain explanation and why it matters: The most important column for rotation timing: when the rains start, how many dry spells break the season, and whether a second crop fits. 0 means no rain that day.
where the meaning comes from: POWER response; wording from POWER parameter name

meaning: Sunlight reaching the ground in total, clouds included
plain explanation and why it matters: Energy available for photosynthesis and for evaporation. Cloudy rainy-season days are lower; clear dry-season days are higher.
where the meaning comes from: POWER response; wording from POWER parameter name

meaning: Surface soil wetness, 0 (dry) to 1 (saturated)
plain explanation and why it matters: How wet the top of the soil is. Matters for seed germination and early seedling survival. A modelled fraction, not a field measurement.
where the meaning comes from: POWER response; depth layer from my memory of POWER docs, not confirmed

meaning: Root zone soil wetness, 0 (dry) to 1 (saturated)
plain explanation and why it matters: How much water the crop roots can reach. Falling values through the season show developing drought stress. Modelled, not measured.
where the meaning comes from: POWER response; depth layer from my memory of POWER docs, not confirmed

meaning: Database table name power_daily: the location key (lat,lon)
plain explanation and why it matters: Identifies which coordinate the stored row belongs to.

meaning: Which POWER parameter the row holds (T2M, RH2M and so on)
plain explanation and why it matters: Data is stored one parameter per row so new parameters can be added without changing the table.

meaning: Day of the value, text YYYY-MM-DD
plain explanation and why it matters: Stored as text so it works the same in SQLite and Postgres.

meaning: The number for that parameter and day
plain explanation and why it matters: Empty (NULL) where POWER reported no value.

meaning: Database table name power_coverage: the location key
plain explanation and why it matters: Same key as in power_daily.

meaning: Parameter this coverage line is about
plain explanation and why it matters: One line per location and parameter.

meaning: Unit POWER reported for the parameter
plain explanation and why it matters: Check this before comparing with other sources.

meaning: First day stored for this location and parameter
plain explanation and why it matters: A new request inside this range is served from the database with no download.

meaning: Last day stored for this location and parameter
plain explanation and why it matters: A request ending later than this triggers a new download.

meaning: Elevation POWER attached to the location
plain explanation and why it matters: Do not use. It is unclear whether it is terrain height or the weather model's own height. SRTM will be the elevation source.

meaning: When the data was downloaded (UTC)
plain explanation and why it matters: Tells you how old the stored copy is.

meaning: Old columns that may still exist empty in your database
plain explanation and why it matters: Ignore them. They held your own rounded coordinate, not the weather grid cell, and were removed from the code.
